candidate.title: Office Hours with an Agent: Who Shows Up?
candidate.abstract: We offered an AI agent as an alternative to human office hours in a large university calculus course. First-generation students used the agent three times as often as human office hours, while their use of human office hours did not drop. Students who used both scored higher on the final exam than students who used either alone.

ranking.why: Which university students turn to an AI agent instead of office hours, and what it does for them.

candidate.title: Bird Song Dialects Shift Within a Decade of Urban Noise
candidate.abstract: Using a self-supervised audio model over 40,000 recordings collected by volunteers from 2014 to 2025, we show that great tits in three European cities raised the minimum pitch of their songs by 220 Hz within ten years, while rural populations did not. The model clusters song dialects without labels, and its clusters match those of expert annotators on 87% of a held-out set.

ranking.why: Self-supervised audio models turning volunteer recordings into a decade-long measurement, far from any Interest.
